description: List active cost-reduction recommendations for this account. Most come from each provider's own already-computed engine (AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Advisor, GCP Recommender); rows with `source` = `plutus` are computed by Plutus itself (rightsizing, and `billing_pattern` below). `type` is one of: `terminate` (an idle resource to shut down), `modify` (an overprovisioned one to downsize), `commitment_savings_plan` or `commitment_reservation` (a commitment worth *buying* — an AWS Savings Plan / Reserved Instance, Azure reservation or savings plan, or GCP committed use discount), or `billing_pattern`. Commitment rows have no `current_instance_type`/`recommended_instance_type` — they are a purchase, not an instance swap; their term, payment option, lookback window and hourly commitment are in `detail`. Only one term/payment/lookback variant per commitment is surfaced (AWS: 30-day lookback, 1-year, no upfront — Cost Explorer's own console default), so do not report these as the only commitment options available. Plutus also computes `billing_pattern` rows (`source` = `plutus`): a known setting that quietly raises the bill, found from billing lines alone. Their `detail` carries `reason`, `spend_usd`, `impact_basis` (`upper_bound` means the saving is a ceiling, at most that figure, not an estimate; say "up to"), `impact_unknown` (true means the saving cannot be estimated, so `estimated_monthly_savings_cents` of 0 is NOT a $0 saving), `where` (service, region, usage types) and `verify` (console links and manual steps to confirm and fix it). Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/savings-recommendations. Each recommendation carries the provider's own figure in its own `currency`; the total is in USD (stated in the response's `currency` field), since providers may bill in different ones. `total_estimated_monthly_savings_cents` is the firm total only: it leaves out `upper_bound` billing patterns, which are reported separately as `upper_bound_findings` ({ count, max_monthly_cents }): say "N findings, up to $X/month", never add that into the total.
name: list_savings_recommendations
